items.name: lede-theme
items.title: Lede theme
items.description: Lede's tokens as shadcn variables in four themes (`light`, `dark`, `light-hc` and `dark-hc`), with Tailwind v4's `@theme` mapping and dark variant, the `.text-*` type classes and the component and block styles. Import `styles/lede/index.css` after your shadcn globals.

items.name: lede-utils
items.title: Lede utils
items.description: `cn()`, LinkProvider (route Lede's anchors through your router), the tone types (`Tone`, `StatusTone` and `ToneSubset`) and the input helpers `focusLanding()` and `lastInputWasTouch()`.

items.name: theme-provider
items.title: ThemeProvider
items.description: ThemeProvider sets scheme, contrast, accent, shape, density and glass for a subtree, and ThemeScope carries them into a portal. It also exports the accent `presets` and `pickOnColor`.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: A native `<button>`, or an `<a>` when given `href`, in five variants. `buttonClass` gives an element of your own the same classes.

items.name: segmented-control
items.title: SegmentedControl
items.description: A native `<fieldset>` of radio inputs, with a thumb that slides to the checked option.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: A Base UI Switch in an enclosing `<label>`. Enter submits its form, as a checkbox's does. Given a `name`, it submits with a form through a hidden native input.

items.name: text-field
items.title: TextField
items.description: A labeled `<input>`, or a `<textarea>` when given `rows`, on Base UI Field, with its hint and error wired up for assistive tech.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: An `` with alt text, or initials on a tint when there's no picture or it fails to load.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: A surface for grouped content, rendered as a `<div>` or the element you pass to `render`. A child with the `ld-concentric` class keeps its corners concentric with the card's.

items.name: list
items.title: ListGroup, ListRow
items.description: ListGroup is a `<section>` with a heading and a `<ul>` of ListRows. A ListRow is a link, a button or a static row, with leading and trailing slots and up to three actions in a ••• menu and a touch swipe, where a disabled action shows its reason.

items.name: disclosure
items.title: Disclosure
items.description: A `<section>` whose heading opens and closes its body, with a summary that reads while it's closed. Built on Base UI Collapsible.

items.name: glass-bar
items.title: GlassBar, GlassToolbar
items.description: GlassBar, a `<nav>` of links between places that marks the current one with `aria-current`, and GlassToolbar, a Base UI Toolbar of actions, both on glass. GlassToolbarButton and GlassToolbarSeparator fill the toolbar.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: A native `<input type="checkbox">` that is its own hit target, sized by density, with an `indeterminate` state.

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: The Table parts for a real `<table>`, with a sticky header and an optional sticky first column. A table wider than its box becomes a named scroll region, and a captioned one can collapse to its caption, with Root holding the open state unless you control it.

items.name: accent-picker
items.title: AccentPicker
items.description: Native radio inputs for ThemeProvider's accent presets, each with a swatch and a visible name.

items.name: app-shell
items.title: AppShell
items.description: A page layout: a skip link, one primary `<nav>` and a `<main>`, where the nav is a sidebar on wide screens and a floating GlassBar on narrow ones. It fits an app with three to five places, each a whole screen.

items.name: empty-state
items.title: EmptyState
items.description: A quiet `<section>` for a place with nothing in it: a heading, one sentence and at most one action.

items.name: form-section
items.title: FormSection
items.description: A native `<fieldset>` and `<legend>` on a card surface, grouping and naming related fields.

items.name: master-detail
items.title: MasterDetail
items.description: A list and its detail as two named regions, side by side on wide screens. On narrow screens the route picks one to show, and `useStackedPanes` says which layout is on.

items.name: page-header
items.title: PageHeader
items.description: A screen's `<h1>` and its one-line summary, with an optional back link and actions. The heading takes focus on mount unless `focusOnMount` is false.

items.name: selection-bar
items.title: SelectionBar
items.description: Bulk actions on glass that appear when something is selected, with the count announced through a live region. `formatCount` writes a count with a `Noun`'s singular or plural.

items.name: step-indicator
items.title: StepIndicator
items.description: An `<ol>` of steps that marks the current one with `aria-current="step"`. Narrow screens show only its summary, such as "Step 2 of 3 · Preferences".

items.name: summary-card
items.title: SummaryCard
items.description: An `<article>` whose heading is a link that covers the card, with a figure, a one-line takeaway and a status in words.

items.name: workbench-shell
items.title: WorkbenchShell
items.description: A top bar over three panels that fill the window, for tools where people keep several things in view. Side panels collapse and resize, and narrow screens show one panel at a time.

items.name: data-table
items.title: DataTable
items.description: A `<table>` with sorting, selection up to every matching row, row links, row actions and paging, plus loading, empty, error and stale states and an optional card layout for narrow containers. `useDataTable` is its model, on TanStack Table behind Lede's own types, for a layout of your own.

items.name: use-server-rows
items.title: useServerRows
items.description: The server-side row model for DataTable: pages fetched on demand and cached per view and page size, shown with Load more or as numbered pages. Duplicate requests merge and out-of-date ones are aborted, and an `{ atLeast }` total becomes exact once `fetchCount` answers or a short last page arrives.

items.name: daily-brief
items.title: DailyBriefFlow
items.description: A hero flow for a daily brief: the day's summary, then cards that link onward, then sections that open in place to their rows.

items.name: inbox
items.title: InboxFlow
items.description: A hero flow from a message list to the open message: row actions in a ••• menu and a swipe, bulk actions in a Select mode and threads that open on their latest message. It shows the last action's outcome with an optional Undo, and says so when a linked message is gone.

items.name: onboarding
items.title: OnboardingFlow
items.description: A hero flow for a three-step sign-up that runs on Enter: native forms with inline errors, a review of every answer and a done screen.

items.name: profile
items.title: ProfileFlow
items.description: A hero flow for a profile: who this is, then the details, edited on the same page. A save is announced, and a failed save keeps the edits with an inline error.

items.name: settings
items.title: SettingsFlow, AppearanceFlow
items.description: A hero flow for settings: SettingsFlow lists grouped settings, each with its value or a switch, and AppearanceFlow is a screen for scheme, accent, corners and accessibility that reports each choice as it's made.
